  MINUTES
  VERNON COMMUNITY FUND GRANT COMMITTEE
  SPECIAL MEETING
  WEDNESDAY, FEBRUARY 21, 2024
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS, 4305 SANTA FE AVENUE

  CALL TO ORDER

  Chair Gaviña called the meeting to order at 10:01 a.m.

  FLAG SALUTE

  Chair Gaviña led the Flag Salute.

  ROLL CALL

  PRESENT:
  Frank Gaviña, Chair
  Mark Gonzalez, Vice Chair
  Ronit Edry, Committee Member
  Clara Gazcon, Committee Member
  Michelle Ybarra, Committee Member

  ABSENT:
  Steven Froberg, Committee Member
  Leticia Lopez, Committee Member

  STAFF PRESENT:
  Zaynah Moussa, City Attorney (via remote access)
  Lisa Pope, City Clerk
  Diana Figueroa, Management Analyst
  Frances Jemmott, Consultant
  James Hull, Consultant

  APPROVAL OF THE AGENDA

  MOTION
  Member Ybarra moved and Member Edry seconded a motion to approve the
  agenda. The question was called and the motion carried 5-0, Members Froberg
  and Lopez absent.

  PUBLIC COMMENT

  None.

  Special Vernon CommUNITY Fund Grant Committee Meeting Minutes  Page 2 of 3
  February 21, 2024

  PRESENTATIONS

  1.  Selection of Chair and Vice Chair

  City Clerk Pope presented the staff report.

  MOTION
  Chair Gaviña moved and Member Edry seconded a motion to select Mark
  Gonzalez to serve as Chair for the term ending on June 30, 2024. The question
  was called and the motion carried 5-0, Members Froberg and Lopez absent.

  MOTION
  Member Gaviña moved and Chair Gonzalez seconded a motion to select Ronit
  Edry to serve as Vice Chair for the term ending on June 30, 2024. The question
  was called and the motion carried 5-0, Members Froberg and Lopez absent.

  CONSENT CALENDAR

  MOTION
  Member Gaviña moved and Vice Chair Edry seconded a motion to approve the
  Consent Calendar. The question was called and the motion carried 5-0, Members
  Froberg and Lopez absent.

  The Consent Calendar consisted of the following item:

  2.  Approval of Minutes
  Recommendation: Approve the September 13, 2023 Special Vernon CommUNITY
  Fund Grant Committee Meeting Minutes.

  NEW BUSINESS

  3.  Fiscal Year 2023-24 Vernon CommUNITY Fund Direct Service Grants

  Management Analyst Figueroa, and Fran Jemmott and James Hull, JRG,
  presented the staff report.

  In response to Committee questions, Management Analyst Figueroa, Ms. Jemmott
  and Mr. Hull explained the Dolores Mission School and Girl Scouts of Greater Los
  Angeles requests for project funding; and grant funding area.

  David Kipen, Libros Schmibros, thanked the CommUNITY Fund and provided an
  overview of the services provided.

  Gia Murillo, Proyecto Pastoral, discussed services provided by the organization.
 DocuSign Envelope ID: 8ED72910-CF69-4503-91E1-B4DD9543B7B7

  Special Vernon CommUNITY Fund Grant Committee Meeting Minutes  Page 3 of 3
  February 21, 2024

  MOTION
  Member Ybarra moved and Member Gazcon seconded a motion to Award Fiscal
  Year 2023-24 Direct Service Grants totaling $142,000 to the following applicants:
  1) Chicxs Rockerxs - $20,000; 2) Dolores Mission School - $15,000; 3) Girl Scouts
  of Greater Los Angeles - $20,000; 4) Jovenes - $12,000; 5) Libros Schmibros -
  $15,000; 6) Neighborhood Music School - $15,000; 7) Proyecto Pastoral - $15,000;
  8) PUENTE Learning Center - $15,000; 9) YMCA Southeast Rio Vista - $15,000.
  The question was called and the motion carried 5-0, Members Froberg and Lopez
  absent.

  ORAL REPORTS

  Management Analyst Figueroa reminded the Committee of the VCF Scholarship
  application period; and acceptance and status of monetary contributions for the
  VCF Scholarship program.

  Ms. Jemmott discussed her disappointing experience with the Scholarship
  America application process and commended the City’s application review
  process.

  ADJOURNMENT

  With no further business, Chair Gonzalez adjourned the meeting at 10:34 a.m.

  ________________________
  MARK GONZALEZ, Chair
